svg.title: face1kb inference scheme
svg.desc: Encode: aligned crop, preparation with the ACCURATE side code, binary budget search over a 64-entry gain table with real rANS byte counts, container of at most B bytes with a 7-byte fixed overhead; overflow policies; decode path.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Inference: a hard byte budget enforced at encode time

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: The encoder measures real rANS output while it searches, so the container never exceeds B bytes in the default mode.

svg.text: flags = variant_id (2 bit: 0 FAST · 1 ACCURATE · 2 identity-only) | rate_index (6 bit, 0-63)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: res = 64→0 · 128→1 · 192→2 · 256→3 · 112→4 · 224→5 · 255 = raw geometry (96, 168 px), followed by the 4-byte H, W trailer

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Fixed overhead 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 7 B. ACCURATE side-channel: the same 8 B for every image with the released weights. No CRC.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: paper_compat=True reproduces the paper bitstreams byte for byte (its accounting ignores the 4-byte trailer at 96/168 px); the default reserves it.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Bitstreams are portable only between identical CUDA devices and software stacks; CUDA-encoded streams do not decode on CPU.
